entries.description: A daily job checks the reverse DNS of the system IPs against the name exim greets with and raises a banner for the admin when one does not match. One line added to the hestia crontab, the rest stays as it is, and the check runs once right away

CrowdSec honours the firewall whitelist and a domain's CrowdSec switch: a whitelisted address and the log of a domain switched off are no longer counted, so no ban arises from them. A domain without a choice yet, i.e. one created before the default, gets the default and is switched on
